notes: ConfigManager itself has a private init() and is a singleton already wired to the real Application Support directory, so it can't be driven directly in a test. Per the source file's header, this replicates the ALGORITHM from ConfigManager's init() catch block (R3) at the level of AppConfig/FileManager instead: on decode failure, copy the unreadable file to a '<original-filename>.corrupt-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>' sibling in the same directory (preserving the original garbage bytes), then fall back to defaults. If ConfigManager.swift's real catch block changes, this fixture must be updated to match. This fixture specifically pins that the ORIGINAL file is left untouched — R3 only copies it to the .corrupt sibling, it never deletes or overwrites the original in place.
